page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.medium is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs and 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. This instance does not include local storage or complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring external block storage and network configurations for operational use.

A key technical characteristic of the ecs.s3.medium is the absence of advanced CPU instruction sets and hardware features. The underlying processor configuration does not expose Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), or hardware-accelerated cryptography flags such as AES and SHA_NI. Additionally, virtualization extensions (VMX, SVM) and hyper-threading (HT) flags are unavailable, which limits its utility for nested virtualization, cryptographic acceleration, and heavy vector-processing workloads.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a low memory-to-vCPU ratio positions this server as a budget-friendly option for compute-centric tasks that do not require large memory footprints or advanced instruction sets. It is suited for basic web serving, lightweight microservices, task queuing, and simple utility hosting where resource predictability is required but memory demands are minimal.
